disqualifier.note: Independently observed prosecution edge-case facts behind a candidate 1.97 window; docs treat them as recorded observations not a masked union, and fixtures write all-false plus mixed pairs.
Docs state the 1.17(p) timing fee and 1.17(v) size fee are independent observed presence facts; constructors and fixtures write mixed pairs (timing true, size false).
Two independently observed acts: the 1.98(a)(4) size-fee assertion vs a 1.97(e) statement. statementType is payload for the latter, not a sibling boolean; fixtures write both flags true together.
Independently observed 1.98 content-item presence bits; docs say every field records presence never satisfaction, and fixtures write mixed true/false combinations.
Independent build-config toggles. projections.ts reads each on its own axis (refresh roots, clobber guard, email skip); examples set includeRefresh+overwrite true with skipEmails false.
Orthogonal parse facts: range vs single locator, and star-pagination vs reporter page. A star-page range is legal; tests construct isRange false + starPage true.

Independently observed parse markers from different eyecite phases (NY unpublished suffix vs blank-page placeholder). Tests set both true together; toBlueBook reads hasBlankPage alone when formatting the page slot.

Independent filesystem existence of sources.jsonl vs the text directory; both must be true to emit a spec, but missing-sources-only, missing-text-only, and both-missing are legal and just drop that root.
